mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ev_charging_log (ev_charger_id, parking_log_id, ev_charging_start_time) VALUES (#{evChargerId}, #{parkingLogId}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE ev_charging_log SET ev_charging_end_time = NOW(), ev_charging_fee = #{evChargingFee}, ev_charging_end_reason = #{evChargingEndReason} WHERE parking_log_id = #{parkingLogId} AND ev_charging_end_time IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT ev_charger_id AS evChargerId, parking_spot_id AS parkingSpotId, ev_charger_type AS evChargerType, ev_charger_state AS evChargerState, ev_charger_power AS evChargerPower FROM ev_charger WHERE parking_spot_id = #{parkingSpotId}
